# Open-Source Frameworks & Runtimes

> Robot-agent frameworks, runtimes and SDKs you can install and run today.  
> Layer: L0-L4 · 26 entries · [overview](../README.md#framework) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- 🟢 [**quackd**](https://github.com/rokbenko/quackd) · 2026-08 — CLI that registers heterogeneous robots through capability manifests and lets an LLM (hosted or local) choose one declared skill at a time in a camera-feedback loop, under a contract on allowed skills, step budgets and human approval; supports multi-robot 'flocks'. _Note: Very early single-developer project; README reports only one real robot (SO-101 arm) tested, other bodies simulated or mocked._
- ⚪ [**ABot-AgentOS**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10350 "ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory") · 2026-07 — Robotic agent operating system above low-level controllers providing scene-conditioned planning, context-isolated skill execution, multi-stage verification, a persistent multimodal graph memory and edge-cloud collaboration; introduces EmbodiedWorldBench. _Note: arXiv metadata lists a GitHub repo and project page under amap-cvlab; neither could be verified from this sandbox._
- 🟢 [**HoloAgent-0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23565 "HoloAgent-0: A Unified Embodied Agent Framework with 3D Spatial Memory") · 2026-06 · Horizon Robotics — Embodied agent framework whose AgentOS turns instructions into executable skill graphs, schedules robot resources, monitors execution and triggers clarification or replanning, coordinating heterogeneous robot models around a 3D spatial memory. [code](https://github.com/HorizonRobotics/HoloAgent) · [project](https://horizonrobotics.github.io/robot_lab/holoagent)
- 🟢 [**PhyAgentOS**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16636 "PhyAgentOS: A Self-Evolving Operating System for Embodied Agents with Decoupled Cognitive Planning and Physical Execution") · 2026-03 · Sun Yat-sen University (HCP Lab); Peng Cheng Laboratory; X-Era Lab — Agent runtime that routes planner tool calls through one versioned gateway to Dora-based robot and simulator endpoints, captures before/after evidence, and lets a task-level verifier accept, fail or trigger bounded replanning; verified episodes become reusable skills. _Note: Code public from 2026-03; technical report posted 2026-07._ [code](https://github.com/PhyAgentOS/PhyAgentOS-core) · [project](https://phy-agent-os.net/)

**2025**

- 🟢 [**Strands Robots**](https://huggingface.co/blog/amazon/strands-lerobot-hub-to-hardware) · 2025-11 · Strands Labs (Strands Agents) — Gives a Strands agent a Robot() tool backed by MuJoCo/Newton/Isaac simulation or real hardware; the agent invokes policies (e.g., GR00T, LeRobot ACT/pi0/SmolVLA) that return action chunks, with the same natural-language control in sim and on robots. [code](https://github.com/strands-labs/robots) · [docs](https://strandsagents.com/)
- 🟢 [**bob_llm**](https://github.com/bob-ros2/bob_llm) · 2025-11 — ROS 2 node that runs an agentic loop against any OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint, keeping conversation state, loading Python tools dynamically, supporting Agent Skills (SKILL.md) discovery and execution, and streaming reasoning tokens to topics.
- 🟢 [**RoboCrew**](https://github.com/Grigorij-Dudnik/RoboCrew) · 2025-10 — Python library (pip install robocrew) for LLM agents on low-cost robots (XLeRobot/LeKiwi, Earth Rover, Unitree Go2): the LLM loops over augmented camera views and calls movement tools and VLA policies as tools, with voice I/O and LiDAR mapping. _Note: Used by the XLeRobot (LeRobot-based) project for LLM agent control._
- 🟢 [**Innate OS**](https://github.com/innate-inc/innate-os) · 2025-10 · Innate — Agentic OS for Innate's MARS home robot: Python skills (code, motions or learned policies), agents that combine skills, a prompt and input streams in an observe-act loop that can interrupt running skills, a browser simulator, and LeRobot dataset/policy integration. _Note: Date is the first tagged release (0.0.1, 2025-10)._ [docs](https://docs.innate.bot/)
- 🟢 [**Reachy Mini Conversation App**](https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/reachy_mini_conversation_app) · 2025-09 · Pollen Robotics (Hugging Face) — Open-source conversational agent app for the Reachy Mini robot: a realtime voice/vision LLM backend calls async tools for choreographed motion, camera capture and MCP tool spaces, with a layered motion system and selectable personalities. [code](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/reachy_mini_conversation_app)

**2024**

- 🟢 [**OM1**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.18588) · 2024-12 · OpenMind — Modular runtime (Go; earlier Python) for multimodal AI agents on robots and simulators: plugins turn sensor inputs into LLM/VLM calls and actions (motion, navigation, speech) over ROS 2, Zenoh or CycloneDDS; supports humanoids, quadrupeds, TurtleBot 4, Gazebo and Isaac Sim. _Note: Linked technical paper (Dec 2024) describes the natural-language data-bus design; default configs call OpenMind-hosted endpoints (API key)._ [code](https://github.com/OpenMind/OM1) · [docs](https://docs.openmind.com/)
- 🟢 [**dimOS**](https://github.com/dimensionalOS/dimos) · 2024-10 · Dimensional — Python robotics SDK ('agentive operating system', no ROS required) where LLM agents run as modules over perception, spatio-temporal memory, navigation and control streams, exposed via a CLI and MCP; supports Unitree Go2/G1, arms and drones (pre-release beta). [docs](https://docs.dimensionalos.com)
- 🟢 [**EmbodiedAgents (EMOS)**](https://github.com/automatika-robotics/embodied-agents) · 2024-09 · Automatika Robotics — ROS 2 framework for composing LLM, VLM, speech and vision components into event-driven agent graphs with spatio-temporal semantic memory, semantic routing, offline local models and auto-generated web UIs; the intelligence layer of Automatika's EMOS. _Note: Initial release 0.1.1 on 2024-09-05 (formerly ros-agents); EMOS umbrella repo at github.com/automatika-robotics/emos (2026)._ [docs](https://agents.automatikarobotics.com/)
- 🟢 [**Stretch AI**](https://github.com/hello-robot/stretch_ai) · 2024-08 · Hello Robot — Open-source software for the Stretch 3 mobile manipulator combining grasping, mapping, navigation, LLM agents, speech I/O and embodied question answering, including dynamic-scene agents (DynaMem); parts derive from Meta's HomeRobot and OK-Robot.
- 🟢 [**ROSA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06472 "Enabling Novel Mission Operations and Interactions with ROSA: The Robot Operating System Agent") · 2024-08 · NASA JPL — LangChain-based agent (pip install jpl-rosa) that lets users inspect, diagnose and operate ROS 1 and ROS 2 systems with natural-language queries by calling ROS tools; extensible with robot-specific tools and prompts (TurtleSim demo, NeBula-Spot). _Note: Date is the first release (v1.0.0 on GitHub/PyPI, 2024-08); paper posted 2024-10._ [code](https://github.com/nasa-jpl/rosa)
- 🟢 [**RAI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07532 "RAI: Flexible Agent Framework for Embodied AI") · 2024-08 · Robotec.ai — ROS 2-native multi-agent framework for embodied AI: LLM/VLM agents with ROS 2 tools, speech (ASR/TTS), open-set perception, NoMaD navigation, simulation connectors, embodiment self-description (whoami) and the rai_bench benchmarking suite. _Note: First tagged release 2024-08 (0.8.0-beta); paper posted 2025-05._ [code](https://github.com/RobotecAI/rai) · [docs](https://robotecai.github.io/rai/)
- 🟢 [**ROS-LLM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19741 "ROS-LLM: A ROS framework for embodied AI with task feedback and structured reasoning") · 2024-06 · Huawei Noah's Ark Lab — ROS framework linking a chat interface and many open/commercial LLMs to ROS actions and services: extracts behaviors from LLM output as sequences, behavior trees or state machines, adds skills via imitation learning, and reflects on human and environment feedback. _Note: Journal version published in Nature Machine Intelligence (2026), doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01186-z._ [code](https://github.com/huawei-noah/HEBO/tree/master/ROSLLM)
- 🟢 [**Embodied Agents (Mbodi)**](https://github.com/mbodiai/embodied-agents) · 2024-06 · Mbodi AI — Python toolkit (pip install mbodied) for adding large multimodal models to existing robot stacks: language, sensory and motor agents (e.g., an OpenVLA motor agent), configurable observation/action spaces and automatic dataset recording.
- 🟢 [**NanoLLM**](https://github.com/dusty-nv/NanoLLM) · 2024-03 · NVIDIA (Jetson AI Lab) — Library for optimized local inference of quantized LLMs and VLMs on Jetson, with speech, vector DB/RAG, web front ends and composable agent pipelines; ROS 2 nodes for it are provided in NVIDIA-AI-IOT/ros2_nanollm. _Note: No commits since 2024-10._ [docs](https://dusty-nv.github.io/NanoLLM/)
- 🟢 [**TCC-IRoNL**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.11838 "The Conversation is the Command: Interacting with Real-World Autonomous Robot Through Natural Language") · 2024-01 — ROS framework that uses LLMs to turn conversational instructions into robot commands or queries and VLMs for scene understanding, with demos on a Unitree Go1 quadruped and a wheeled robot in simulation and the real world. [code](https://github.com/LinusNEP/TCC-IRoNL)
- 🟢 [**MachinaScript for Robots**](https://github.com/babycommando/machinascript-for-robots) · 2024-01 — Hobbyist toolkit and LLM-JSON action language: an LLM (optionally with vision) emits MachinaScript sequences that a parser turns into commands for Arduino/Raspberry Pi servos, cameras and sensors. _Note: Early beta; no commits since 2024-09._

**2023**

- 🟢 [**ros2ai**](https://github.com/fujitatomoya/ros2ai) · 2023-11 — ros2 CLI extension ('ros2 ai query/exec') that answers ROS 2 questions and executes the matching ros2 commands from natural-language requests, using OpenAI-compatible APIs or local Ollama models; installable as a ROS 2 package.
- 🟢 [**ROSGPT_Vision**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11236 "ROSGPT_Vision: Commanding Robots Using Only Language Models' Prompts") · 2023-08 · Prince Sultan University (RIOTU Lab) — ROS 2 framework built on a 'Prompting Robotic Modalities' pattern: a visual prompt drives a VLM (e.g., LLaVA, MiniGPT-4) and an LLM prompt regulates the robot's reaction; demonstrated with CarMate, a driver-distraction monitor. [code](https://github.com/bilel-bj/ROSGPT_Vision)
- 🟢 [**ROS-LLM (Auromix)**](https://github.com/Auromix/ROS-LLM) · 2023-06 · Auromix — ROS 2 Humble package that lets GPT-4/ChatGPT drive robot motion and navigation from text or speech (cloud ASR or local Whisper) by calling robot functions that users expose through a simple interface; keeps local chat history. _Note: No commits since 2023-07._
- 🟢 [**ROSGPT**](https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202304.0827.v2 "ROSGPT: Next-Generation Human-Robot Interaction with ChatGPT and ROS") · 2023-04 · Prince Sultan University — ROS 2 package that uses ChatGPT to convert unstructured natural-language commands into structured JSON robot commands, demonstrated on Turtlesim and TurtleBot3. _Note: Preprints.org preprint (Apr 2023); journal version in Software - Practice and Experience (2024)._ [code](https://github.com/aniskoubaa/rosgpt)
- 🟢 [**llama_ros**](https://github.com/mgonzs13/llama_ros) · 2023-04 — ROS 2 packages that run GGUF LLMs and VLMs locally through llama.cpp, exposing generation, embeddings, GBNF-grammar-constrained output, runtime LoRA swapping and a LangChain integration to ROS 2 nodes.

**2022**

- 🟢 [**dora-rs**](https://github.com/dora-rs/dora) · 2022-11 · dora-rs community — Rust dataflow framework ('Agentic Dataflow-Oriented Robotic Architecture') for real-time robotics and AI apps: Rust, Python and C++ nodes exchange messages over zero-copy shared memory and Zenoh, with a node hub for cameras, YOLO, LLMs, TTS and more. _Note: Middleware layer rather than an agent loop; used as the execution backend by PhyAgentOS. dora 1.0 released 2026-09._ [docs](https://dora-rs.ai/)
